verdict.rationale: jo's own homepage says the agent comes "with its own browser," and that it runs on a dedicated cloud machine that can work overnight and "watch what changed." That points to a first-party browser-operating capability, but it rests on a single thin marketing mention with no detail. missing for 10: documentation of how jo drives the browser (navigation, clicking, form-filling, completing transactions), evidence of web research workflows, limits and permissions for acting on sites, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can have the assistant operate a web browser on my behalf to research and complete tasks on websites

citations.quote: with its own browser, phone, and email address.
because jo has its own machine, it can work overnight: read what came in, watch what changed, and prepare your morning before you wake.
